Credit card benefits: Choosing the right card can save money

Choosing a credit card based on its overall value proposition, rather than just headline benefits, is advised for maximizing savings. Focusing on core travel-centric benefits can lead to significant financial advantages. Failing to select the appropriate card could result in missing out on potential savings, estimated by one outlet to be up to ₹2 lakh annually.
